name: Rasan Information Technology Co.
note: Saudi fintech (Tameeni insurance aggregator), listed on the Saudi Exchange Main Market in June 2024 (sold 30% of shares). At the IPO MENAbytes named Saudi venture-capital firm Impact46 as its largest shareholder (18.65% pre-IPO, 13.06% after); Impact46's own site now lists Rasan among its exits, so its current stake and the rest of the register are unverified. No state ownership named in IPO coverage.
